topics.title: Lowjack Device Advertisement
topics.summary: A radio advertisement promotes the ‘lowJack’ device for vehicle tracking. The segment discusses car theft rates in New Jersey and suggests using lowJack to prevent stolen vehicles, highlighting its ability to alert law enforcement via a phone number.

topics.title: Inmate Lawrence Singleton’s Criminal Activity
topics.summary: Lawrence Singleton, previously convicted of assault and later diagnosed with AIDS, attempted to attack a corrections officer. He was found guilty of attempted murder before being arrested for shoplifting at a dinner theater and purchasing an axe.

topics.title: Criminal Cases and Courtroom Details
topics.summary: A man serving eight years after shoplifting, including chainsaw theft, resides in Tampa, Florida. Another individual faces potential life imprisonment due to an insanity defense related to the Happy Land social club fire that killed 87 people.

topics.title: Murder Case and Stand-Up Discussion
topics.summary: A lawyer discusses a murder case involving a man who lived with his family while they were dead. Comedian Sam Kennison then talks about preparing material for an appearance, including jokes referencing Sammy Davis Jr.'s neck and interactions with interviewer Dave.

topics.title: Conversation About Interviewing and Health Products
topics.summary: Two men discuss strategies for conducting interviews with guests while attempting to create spontaneous conversations. They then shift the conversation to discussing health products like Nutri System and amyl nitrate, consulting with a Beverly Hills cardiologist regarding their potential benefits.

topics.title: Discussion of Dieting and Food Choices
topics.summary: Participants discuss dieting strategies, including Nutri System, while sharing anecdotes about unhealthy food choices like lobster and muffins. The program repeatedly announces a phone number for the service alongside comments regarding guest thinness.
